vb_textbox.text: The advice I can give you is to try and remember the colors in 2 different groups (green, red, blue, yellow) and (brown, purple, orange, pink). A color from both groups will be chosen against each other. Select the color that is earning the most mushrooms and keep selecting a color from that group until it starts yielding less mushrooms, then swap to the other group after a couple of rounds when you notice it again. Keep going until you have figured out the momentum shift. Good luck!
